Package de.hof.dms.cmis

Class CmisService

java.lang.Object
de.hof.dms.cmis.CmisService
@Service @Profile("!no-mongo") public class CmisService extends Object
CMIS 1.1 operations (Browser/JSON binding) over the DMS data model. Every operation enforces the same RBAC as the REST API by reusing PermissionService and the existing document/folder services, so a caller can never see or mutate anything through CMIS that the REST API would deny. Object-type mapping: cmis:folder ↔ folders, cmis:document ↔ documents.

      query: runs a restricted CMIS-SQL statement over the RBAC-enforced search index. Only CONTAINS('...') full-text and cmis:name = '...' predicates are supported.
